response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_mean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as station_mean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(station_mean) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(station_mean) - (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_avg) as above_average_amount FROM station_avgs
